assumptions.choice: Aggregate the supplied 15-minute bars into daily closes and calculate a 14-period Wilder RSI from completed daily bars.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment supplies only one 15-minute feed, while the specification requires a daily RSI.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate the completed prior day's RSI when the first bar of a new trading day arrives, then submit the entry order; Backtrader executes that market order on the following 15-minute bar.
assumptions.reason: A daily close is not known until its trading day has completed, and using it earlier would introduce look-ahead bias.

assumptions.choice: Use size = 1% of current broker value divided by 0.1% of the signal-bar close.
assumptions.reason: The exact next-bar fill price is unavailable when a standard Backtrader market order is submitted; this is the closest executable calculation to the stated 1% stop-loss risk.

assumptions.choice: Use one EUR/USD pip as 0.0001 and add it to the favorable take-profit movement: above the long target and below the short target.
assumptions.reason: OHLCV data has no bid/ask prices, so a literal bid/ask spread cannot be applied; this implements the stated requirement that profit requires one pip beyond take-profit.
